declared_variants.length_dependence: disabled, phi=1 and tau_c=tau_c0; Rodero S4 does not publish ldOn/lambda0/ld/ld_up
declared_variants.deformation_gradient: identity on the source CT end-diastolic coordinates; stress-free configuration is not supplied
declared_variants.cell_activation: linear nodal timing interpolated at four symmetric tetrahedral quadrature points
declared_variants.active_stress: first Piola at F=I is T_a f0 outer f0; source fibre vectors are normalized without modifying source bytes
declared_variants.output_sign: positive FEM internal residual integral P grad(N) dV; an applied external nodal load would have the opposite sign
declared_variants.mechanical_node_identity: original source node IDs, including three point-only LV/RV contacts; electrical timing keeps those contacts separate
